name: Hananiah
bio: Hananiah son of Azzur, a prophet from Gibeon, publicly contradicted Jeremiah's warnings by prophesying that the LORD would soon break Babylon's hold on Judah and bring back the exiles and the temple vessels within two years. He dramatically broke the symbolic wooden yoke Jeremiah wore as a sign; Jeremiah replied that Hananiah had only given the people false hope, and that he himself would die within the year for making the people trust a lie. Hananiah died two months later (Jeremiah 28:1-17).
